core.text: Protect the exact anomaly: B9 has the same ten-bracket packing mark as the others but contains nine brackets. Count, add the available spare, recount ten, and seal; B9 requires two inspection minutes. A mark cannot substitute for that completed release.

Proposed model sequence: trolley B4-B7 during 0-3, trolley B8-B11 during 3-6, then hand carry B12 during 6-7. Inspect continuously: B1-B8 finish at boundaries 1-8, B9 during 8-10, and B10-B12 finish 11-13. Completion-first unloading permits both whole trolley loads and B12 without waiting. Predicted output is nine unloads and twelve correct releases; transfer burden seven minutes and inspection burden thirteen. This is a calculation, not an observed run.

Closest rival: consecutive hand trips for B4-B12 during 0-9 with identical mandatory inspections. Replay both schedules using the clock and ledger; record first B9 count, corrected recount, completed releases, occupied intervals, occupancy and charge. Both predict completion at 13; hand-only predicts nine transfer minutes versus seven. During B9 inspection, count before adding the spare: this separates mark-as-count from physical-shortfall accounts without interrupting correction.

residue.text: The mark-as-count account is already defeated by stipulated O6; retain it as the explicit rejected explanation, never as an admissible fact. A first count of nine also defeats its probe prediction. Twelve packing marks cannot establish success. Defeat the proposed operational sequence if legal ledger replay yields fewer than twelve correct completions by 13, insufficient unloading space, or transfer occupation exceeding seven.

B9 discrepancy cause remains unknown. The count probe distinguishes present-count accounts, not marking error from an earlier inventory change. No further window losses or arrivals are allowed. Later request adaptation is unobserved; no future rate, empirical trial, or global optimum is established. Additional resources are unavailable.

tension.account_a: Rejected mark-as-count account: the ten mark certifies ten physical brackets; the discrepancy is merely a recording mismatch. This hypothesis conflicts with protected O6.
tension.account_b: Physical-shortfall account: identical marking coexists with nine actual B9 brackets, requiring the stipulated correction before release.
